templates.why_chosen: A genuine branching computation graph: coloured grid cells for two modalities and a backbone are linked by red curved data-dependency arrows crossing rows, feeding a tree-search icon and a pipeline-interleave grid.
templates.what_to_learn: Colour each node by which of several node types it belongs to (green/orange/blue for the three modality classes here) and let curved red arrows, not orthogonal routing, carry the cross-row data dependencies; pair the graph with a small tree icon standing in for the search procedure that reorders it.
